capabilities: Create or open a daily note for a future date via ribbon icon or command
Substitute date, time, and title tokens in templates
Create intermediate destination folders before writing the note
Focus an existing future note without altering its contents
Configure date format, day offset, folder path, and template file
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it can also be installed via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in Daily Notes and Periodic Notes plugins are designed for the current day.
motivation: The author built it because planning ahead in the evening is tedious and error-prone: date-format workarounds evaluate as plain text and overwrites can reset notes drafted in advance.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Daily Notes only targets the current day, so planning tomorrow's note means manually calculating dates and risking overwriting a note already drafted in advance.

relations.evidence: Obsidian's built-in Daily Notes and Periodic Notes plugins are designed for the current day.

summary: Creates or opens tomorrow's (or +N days ahead) daily note without overwriting existing content, filling a template with date and time tokens.
